column4: componentize-py and wasm-tools are not installed on this runner, and this test needs a real componentized Python guest: it makes a Python workflow send an invalid service, operation, promise, signal or workflow name through twelve host imports and checks each is refused as the core-module path refuses it (a call error, the errBadParam word, or a trap, by result type) with no collaborator and no history event reached. Whole test with no dialect arm, so the job's DSNs do not change the count. NOT MEASURED on this job: the count of 1 is the one test that skips when the toolchain is missing, read from pythonEntryEngine's t.Skip, not a reading of the job's own report; if the first CI report differs, correct this line. It runs for real in scripts/docker/python-toolchain.Dockerfile (measured there: passes). (cleat#3436)
